mapper.sql: SELECT v.*, u.nickname AS create_by_name, COALESCE(c.item_count, 0) AS item_count, COALESCE(c.make_count, 0) AS make_count, COALESCE(c.zero_count, 0) AS zero_count FROM fin_std_cost_version v LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.create_by LEFT JOIN ( SELECT version_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count, SUM(make) AS make_count, SUM(CASE WHEN make = 0 AND material_cost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_count FROM fin_std_cost GROUP BY version_id ) c ON c.version_id = v.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY v.effective_period DESC, v.id DESC
SELECT * FROM fin_std_cost_version WHERE status = 'RELEASED' AND effective_period <= #{period} ORDER BY effective_period DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
